msg: Control flow of non-void function ends here!
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 6515e48932c.c (Linux OMAP). 'Control flow of non-void function ends here!' at lines 18-20, when def(CONFIG_MACH_OMAP_H4). The function in question is main() which lacks an explicit return statement. In C99, main() without an explicit return is valid — it implicitly returns 0. The alarm is a false positive. The known vbdb bug for this file is the UndeclaredIdentifier on omap2_set_globals_242x() when CONFIG_ARCH_OMAP2420=false (the function is only defined inside #if ARCH_OMAP2420, but called unconditionally inside #ifdef MACH_OMAP_H4).
